experiments.study_type: Induction of acute cholestasis by common bile duct ligation
experiments.procedure_text: Mice underwent common bile duct ligation or sham operation. Animals were sacrificed 5 days after BDL, and plasma and tissues were collected.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: The bile duct was isolated from the surrounding tissues, and a 7-0 silk ligature was tied at proximal and distal end to the liver hilus. Finally, the bile duct was resected between the two ligatures. In sham-operated animals, the bile duct was only isolated but not ligated. The animals were sacrificed 5 days after BDL
experiments.route_evidence: received 60 μg/ kg body weight of buprenorphine subcutaneously

endpoints.label: mRNA sequencing
endpoints.evidence: Total RNA concentration of 1-2 μg was used for mRNA sequencing

endpoints.label: respirometry
endpoints.evidence: The oxygen consumption rates (OCRs) in homogenates from frozen livers were measured
